newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela foreign reserves rise to $15.967 bln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela foreign reserves rise to $15.967 bln.

text.p: Venezuela's total foreign reserves rose $557 million, or 3.6 percent, in the week to March 31 to $15.967 billion, according to figures released by the central bank on Friday.
Reserves were up from $15.410 billion on March 24, the bank's latest weekly bulletin of indicators showed.
Foreign reserves are now up $738 million, or 4.8 percent, since the beginning of the year.
Reserves closed last year at $15.229 billion and are expected to top $20 billion by the end of 1997, officials have said.
